## 2. Six-Criteria Score

Score each criterion from `0` to `5`. Minimum recommended approval threshold: no score below `3`, total score `>= 22/30`, and unit economics passing the deterministic profitability gate.

| Criterion | Score | Evidence file/link | Notes |
|---|---:|---|---|
| US fit |  |  | shipping, returns, tax, customer expectation |
| Supplier reliability |  |  | lead times, MOQ, sample quality, communication |
| Unit economics |  |  | landed cost, fees, shipping, CPA, margin |
| Differentiation |  |  | uniqueness, defensibility, perceived value |
| Demand signal |  |  | search, competitor ads, social proof |
| Operational simplicity |  |  | return risk, warranty, support complexity |
| **Total** | **0/30** |  |  |

---

## 3. Required Evidence Checklist

- [ ] Supplier product URL recorded.
- [ ] Supplier price recorded.
- [ ] Shipping price to US recorded.
- [ ] Delivery estimate to US recorded.
- [ ] Return address / return policy documented.
- [ ] MOQ or stocking constraint documented.
- [ ] Product images/video evidence saved.
- [ ] At least 5 competitors identified.
- [ ] Demand evidence file attached.
- [ ] Margin/profitability calculation attached.
- [ ] US compliance checklist completed.
- [ ] No restricted, counterfeit, medical, safety-critical, or regulated claims detected.

## 7. Hypothesis

A valid hypothesis must contain numeric predictions.

```text
This product is expected to reach CTR __%, CVR __%, CPA $__, and net margin $__ per sale in the US pilot because __.
```
